Definition: a primary verb; to "grave", especially to write; figuratively, to describe:--describe, write(-ing, -ten).
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, gráphō is the word for describe, write(-ing, -ten). In Luke 1:3, the text says "to write unto thee in order." In John 1:45, the text says "did write."
TheologicalSignificance: gráphō convinces me that God's Word means what it says, and this word is part of how He speaks plainly to us. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: The Calling of the First Disciples; The Magi Visit Jesus
